examples.trans: Grazie, signora, your table by the window is already completely ready!

examples.text: Итальянский гость с улыбкой сказал официанту граци за отличный кофе.
examples.trans: With a smile the Italian guest said grazie to the waiter for the excellent coffee.

meanings.note: emphatic at the start of a sentence
Disbelief.
на днях = in the next few days, or the other day

examples.trans: I'll call in the next few days.

meanings.note: About people.
in greetings: добрый день, добрый вечер

examples.text: Добрый вечер, Вика. С Новым годом!
examples.trans: Good evening, Vika. Happy New Year!

как тебя зовут? = what's your name? меня зовут ... = my name is ...

звонить.gloss: to call, to phone; to ring

meanings.note: + dative of the person.
A bell or phone.

examples.trans: Hello! How was it in Hungary?

meanings.note: + genitive: 'из мэрии' = from the town hall

examples.text: Марина Сергеевна, я уже знаю. Мне звонили из мэрии.
examples.trans: Marina Sergeyevna, I already know. The town hall called me.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
accusative/genitive его (него after prepositions), dative ему (нему)
For masculine and neuter things. Core Russian pron meaning 'he; it' in everyday speech.

meanings.en: other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)
meanings.note: Case forms. Core Russian pron meaning 'he; it' in everyday speech.
High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'to her', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Она нашла нас на новом месте.
examples.trans: She found us at the new place.
That is it, she got really offended.
She is not answering her phone.

meanings.note: Prefix 'от-' ('away from, off') marks separation, completion, or response (stem 'меняться').

examples.text: С этого момента вся правда отменяется!
examples.trans: From this moment on, all truth is canceled!

передать.gloss: to pass on, to hand over

meanings.en: to pass on, to hand over, to give
meanings.note: + accusative and dative (кому). Prefix 'пере-' denotes crossing over, repeating, or exceeding a limit (stem 'дать').

examples.trans: Please pass on my regards to your mum.

examples.text: Всё, я ухожу. Ребёнок ни при чём. Передай это Алексею.
examples.trans: That's it, I'm leaving. The child isn't to blame. Give this to Alexei.

meanings.note: Informal. Core Russian interj meaning 'bye' in everyday speech.
As an adverb. Core Russian interj meaning 'bye' in everyday speech.

examples.text: Правда, Нин, всё нормально. Скажи что-нибудь, пожалуйста.
examples.trans: Honestly, Nina, everything's fine. Say something, please.
A representative of the exhibition from Milan called.

examples.text: Сегодня утром звонил официальный представитель выставки из Милана.
examples.trans: An official representative of the exhibition from Milan called this morning.

examples.text: В зале сидит представитель крупной французской винодельни.
examples.trans: A representative of a major French winery is sitting in the dining room.

meanings.note: Кого о чём. Prefix 'пред-' ('before, fore-') indicates anticipation or prior position (stem 'упредить').

examples.trans: And they warned me very strictly!

meanings.note: Dining establishment. Borrowed from French 'restaurant' (from 'restaurer', to restore strength with rich broth); entered Russian in the early 19th century.

examples.trans: They called from the Italian restaurant.
In the evening they went to a restaurant.

examples.text: Кстати, звонили из итальянского ресторана. Дарят папе романтический ужин на двоих.
examples.trans: By the way, they called from the Italian restaurant. They're giving Dad a romantic dinner for two.

meanings.note: once; что скажешь? = what do you say?
Polite request. Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'казать').

examples.trans: Tell us, when will your programme be out?

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: уже четыре года = for four years now

examples.text: Я уже четыре года работаю мэром.
examples.trans: I've been mayor for four years now.

улететь.gloss: to fly away, to depart by plane

meanings.en: to fly away, to fly out, to depart by air
meanings.note: Prefix у- = away. Prefix 'у-' marks departure, removal, or successful completion (stem 'лететь').

examples.trans: What do you mean you didn't fly out?
Our plane has already flown out.

examples.text: Да, Аллочка? Как ты не улетела? Почему?
examples.trans: Yes, Allochka? What do you mean you didn't fly out? Why?

meanings.note: How something is done. Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.
As an answer. Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Граци, синьора, чао-чао, ждём вас снова завтра вечером!
examples.trans: Grazie, signora, ciao-ciao, we look forward to seeing you again tomorrow evening!

examples.text: Луи весело помахал всем рукой и крикнул чао-чао.
examples.trans: Louis cheerfully waved his hand to everyone and called out ciao-ciao.

чуть не + verb: я чуть не упал = I nearly fell

examples.text: Садись, не бойся. Я ведь сам чуть тебя не отпустил.
examples.trans: Sit down, don't be afraid. I very nearly let you go myself.
